history.dynasty: Founded by Gaudiya Vaishnava saints Rupa Goswami and Sanatana Goswami
history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: CSV town is 'Malda'; the temple is actually at Ramkeli village in the ruined medieval city of Gauda, ~25 km from Malda (English Bazar). Established in 1509 by Mahavaishnavas Rupa Goswami and Sanatana Goswami. On 15 June 1515 Chaitanya Mahaprabhu met them here on his journey to Vrindavan. The present Dalan-plus-Ratna style building was constructed in 1938 (1345 Bangabda); the West Bengal tourism department took up renovation in 2016 (~₹6 crore allotted). Administered by the Madana Mohan Jiu Trust Committee. The Ramkeli fair, held around mid-June (Joishtho Sankranti), draws Vaishnava devotees for kirtan.

name: Madan Mohan Temple, Ramkeli
town_description: Ramkeli is a historic village in Malda district near the medieval city of Gauda, revered in Gaudiya Vaishnavism as the land of Rupa and Sanatana Goswami.

travel.airport: Bagdogra Airport (~250 km) or Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, Kolkata (~340 km)
travel.road: Ramkeli village, ~25 km from English Bazar (Malda town), off NH-12; local transport available from Malda

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; the Ramkeli Mela is held around mid-June
